post.summary:
B-07: adds a trainer to a plan. Safe to retry: a trainer already on the plan returns the existing record
with alreadyAssigned = true. Other trainers on the plan are kept.

400.description: The plan is closed or canceled, or the user is not an active FAST trainer.

post.summary: B-08: removes a trainer from a plan. Safe to retry: a trainer who is not on the plan returns removed = false.

400.description: The plan is closed; a delivered plan keeps its trainer.

post.summary: B-09: sets the plan's training material status and, when a file is sent, replaces the material file (max 50 MB).

File.description: Optional: the approved material file. Omit to change only the status.

400.description: Unknown status code, a rejected file, or the plan is final-closed or canceled.

get.summary: Downloads the plan's current training material file.
B-10: trainees with a confirmed registration on the plan (names only), with attendance per session.
B-11: status, schedule, Teams link and cancellation of one plan.
B-04: a programme's brief, sectors, job families, trainee level and prospectus.
B-05: the plans of a programme.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: open (new or open plans), or one plan status code: new, open, closed, final-closed, canceled. Omit for all.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Only plans starting on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

get.summary: B-06: the full plan record: schedule, venue, language, delivery mode, training material and trainers.
Downloads the programme prospectus.

B-12: the trainer's MTM rating on the plan, plus the plan's trainee survey answers.
FAST does not link survey answers to a trainer, so the answers are the plan's.

404.description: The trainer is not on the plan.

get.summary: B-14: closed and final-closed plans the trainer delivered, newest first. An unknown trainer returns an empty list.

alreadyAssigned.description: True when the trainer was already on the plan and nothing changed.

status.description: present | absent. FAST records no "excused" state.

AttendanceDto.description: One row per session the trainee was marked for.

downloadUrl.description: Relative to the API base URL; call it with the same service token.

code.description: Stable language-neutral code, where FAST has one (e.g. plan status "open"); otherwise null.

isActive.description: False for retired values that stay readable on old records.

parentId.description: The parent row: a city's country, a sub-sector's sector. Null when the list is flat.

LookupItemDto.description: A row of a reference list.

code.description: Stable language-neutral code, where FAST has one (e.g. plan status "open"); otherwise null.

NamedRefDto.description: A lookup value inside a record. All ids are strings: FAST mixes int and GUID keys.

period.description: morning | evening, read from the first session's start time (before 12:00 is morning). FAST stores no such field.

clientOrganizations.description: The client organizations of a private plan; empty for public plans.

hasTrainer.description: False means the plan still needs a trainer.

sectors.description: A programme can belong to several sectors.

status.description: active (published current version) | inactive (unpublished current version) | archived (superseded version).

isCustom.description: A private (custom) programme built for one client.

searchText.description: Optional: matches the Arabic name, English name or programme code.

status.description: active | inactive | archived. Omit for active and inactive.

hasUpcomingPlans.description: Only programmes with a new or open plan that has not started yet.

value.description: 1 (weak) to 5 (excellent); null when the trainee was marked absent.

planSurveyResponses.description:
Trainee survey answers for the whole plan. FAST does not record which trainer a survey answer is about,
so on a plan with several trainers these are shared.

removed.description: False when the trainer was not on the plan (for example a retry after a successful removal).
